Agent Name: Financial_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The analyst computed the revenue-to-rent ratio without properly cleaning the data. They only dropped rows with missing "Name," leaving non-vendor separator rows like "Zone 2" (and any rows with missing/zero Revenue or Rent) in the dataset. This can introduce NaN/inf values into the ratio column and potentially skew idxmin selection, leading to the wrong vendor/type being identified instead of the correct "Finance." They should have filtered out non-vendor rows and dropped entries with missing or zero Rent/Revenue before calculating ratios.
